name: Westinghouse Electric Company
monetization: Sells AP1000/AP300 reactors, nuclear fuel, and services; owned by Brookfield (51%) and Cameco (49%); anchor of the $80B US-government new-build program.

observations.metric_label: US-government AP1000 fleet partnership (announced program value)
observations.notes: Announced Oct 27, 2025: ≥$80B of AP1000 reactors with Commerce Dept; US government receives 20% of distributions above $17.5B. Announced program value, not realized spend; first units unlikely to deliver power before the early-to-mid 2030s.
